title: Learn-by-interact: A Data-Centric Framework For Self-Adaptive Agents in Realistic Environments
authors_zh: Hongjin Su、Ruoxi Sun、Jinsung Yoon、Pengcheng Yin、Tao Yu、Sercan Ö. Arık
paper_type_zh: 智能体交互数据构造方法与扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究如何把不完美的环境交互转化为 SFT 或智能体训练数据，以及审计目标重标注、模型委员会筛选、相关子轨迹和未开放工件带来的风险
one_line: The recipe expands 85,905 documentation-seeded agent episodes into 1,456,808 instruction-subtrajectory candidates and reports 440,008 committee-filtered examples, but releases neither the corpus nor its implementation.
Learn-by-interact 将 85,905 条由文档任务驱动的智能体交互轨迹扩展为 1,456,808 个指令—子轨迹候选，经双模型一致筛选后报告 440,008 条样本，但未发布语料、实现或模型。
why: It exposes a reusable pattern for turning imperfect environment exploration into post-training data, while making clear that instruction-behavior alignment, original-task success, provenance, and open release are separate audit questions.
inclusion_reason: Learn-by-interact is a concrete construction recipe for reasoning-bearing agent data: documentation-seeded tasks produce executable environment interactions, backward construction converts every subtrajectory into an aligned instruction pair, and a mixed duplicate/LLM-committee filter prepares examples for agentic ICL and SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Agent adaptation in realistic software, web, desktop, and data-engineering environments is constrained by the scarcity of action-level supervision. Human annotators must understand both the task and a stateful interface, execute long action sequences, and diagnose environment-specific failures. Learn-by-interact asks whether commonly available documentation and autonomous interaction can replace manual trajectory labeling.

The paper's concrete data object is an environment-specific instruction-subtrajectory pair. A trajectory alternates observations and actions, and a retained record has a newly constructed instruction \(I'\) plus a contiguous segment \(T'=(o_i,a_{i+1},o_{i+1},\ldots,a_j,o_j)\). The instruction may summarize the executed steps or abstract their apparent purpose. It is not necessarily the task that originally caused the agent to act.

This distinction is central. The generating agent can fail, detour, or execute only part of its initial task. Rather than discard every such episode, backward construction asks what the observed segment actually accomplished and relabels it accordingly. That can recover useful local behavior, but instruction-behavior alignment after relabeling is not evidence that the original task succeeded, that the path was efficient, or that the behavior was safe.

The ICLR final reports a four-stage accounting chain: 28,635 source documents produce 85,905 raw trajectories, all contiguous segments yield 1,456,808 candidate instruction-subtrajectory pairs, and filtering retains 440,008 examples. The pools are constructed separately for SWE-bench-Lite, WebArena, OSWorld, and Spider2-V.

This Card belongs in Data Construction & Open Release Recipes because the contribution is a concrete recipe for turning source resources and environment interaction into agent-training examples. “Open release” remains an audit dimension, not a property established by publication: no official code repository, generated dataset, project page, model checkpoint, dataset card, or immutable release was found.

在真实的软件工程、网页、桌面和数据工程环境中，智能体适配受到动作级监督稀缺的限制。人工标注者既要理解任务和有状态界面，又要执行很长的动作序列并诊断环境特有的失败。Learn-by-interact 研究的是：能否用常见文档和自主交互，替代人工轨迹标注。

论文中的具体数据对象是“环境特定的指令—子轨迹对”。轨迹由观察与动作交替组成；一条保留记录包含重新构造的指令 \(I'\)，以及连续片段 \(T'=(o_i,a_{i+1},o_{i+1},\ldots,a_j,o_j)\)。指令可以概括已执行的步骤，也可以抽象这段行为的表面目的。它不一定是最初促使智能体行动的任务。

这个区别是理解论文的关键。生成智能体可能失败、绕路，或只完成初始任务的一部分。后向构造并非丢弃所有这类回合，而是询问观察到的片段实际做了什么，再据此改写标签。这样可能回收有用的局部行为；但重标注后的指令—行为一致，不代表原始任务成功，也不能证明路径高效或行为安全。

ICLR 终稿给出四阶段统计链：28,635 份源文档产生 85,905 条原始轨迹；枚举所有连续片段后得到 1,456,808 个候选指令—子轨迹对；筛选后保留 440,008 条样本。SWE-bench-Lite、WebArena、OSWorld 和 Spider2-V 分别构建自己的数据池。

本工作属于 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes，因为主要贡献是一套把源资源和环境交互转换成智能体训练样本的具体配方。“开放发布”在这里是审计维度，并非论文发表就自动成立：尚未找到官方代码仓库、生成数据集、项目页、模型检查点、dataset card 或不可变发布版本。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core move is backward construction: generate a behavior first, then derive an instruction that describes the behavior actually present in a contiguous subtrajectory. This reverses the usual instruction-first assumption that a trajectory is valid only when it completes its seed task.

The contract can be summarized as follows:

| Element | Observed or generated object | |---|---| | Seed resource | Documentation, tutorial, FAQ, or non-repeated SWE-bench-Lite Python file | | Initial task | One of three Claude-3.5-Sonnet instructions sampled per source document | | Environment behavior | Claude-3.5-Sonnet actions and resulting observations until stop or the environment limit | | Candidate record | A contiguous observation-action subtrajectory paired with a summary or purpose-abstraction instruction | | Mechanical filter | Remove consecutive repeated action-observation states associated with inactivity or environment errors | | Model filter | Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-1.5-Pro must both judge the pair coherent, natural, reasonable, and instruction-aligned | | Downstream object | A retrieved in-context demonstration or a next-action SFT example |

The feedback contract is mixed. Environment execution supplies state transitions and benchmark evaluators later measure task completion, while the construction filter combines a repeated-state rule with a two-model semantic committee. The committee does not execute the constructed instruction or prove end-state success; it judges textual and behavioral plausibility from the presented pair. Per-record votes, rationales, confidence, rejection reasons, and exact model revisions are not released.

Enumerating all contiguous segments gives quadratic candidate growth in trajectory length. The ICLR final counts make the expansion visible: 85,905 raw trajectories become 1,456,808 candidates before 440,008 survive filtering. This increases data yield from expensive interactions, but also creates families of heavily overlapping records whose shared episode provenance should be preserved for grouping, deduplication, and leakage analysis.

The same accepted pool supports two uses. For training-free adaptation, agentic retrieval selects demonstrations at each decision step. For training-based adaptation, records are converted into next-action prediction examples for supervised fine-tuning. The evidence supports sft and agent_training; it does not establish preference optimization, reward-model training, or policy-gradient RL.

核心做法是后向构造：先生成行为，再从连续子轨迹中推导描述实际行为的指令。它反转了通常的“先有指令”假设，不再要求一条轨迹只有完成种子任务时才有价值。

其数据与反馈契约可概括如下：

| 要素 | 观察或生成的对象 | |---|---| | 种子资源 | 文档、教程、FAQ 或 SWE-bench-Lite 中不重复的 Python 文件 | | 初始任务 | Claude-3.5-Sonnet 针对每份源文档采样的三条指令之一 | | 环境行为 | Claude-3.5-Sonnet 的动作及其产生的观察，直到停止或达到环境步数上限 | | 候选记录 | 连续观察—动作子轨迹，以及概括步骤或抽象目的的新指令 | | 机械筛选 | 删除与无动作或环境错误有关的连续重复动作—观察状态 | | 模型筛选 | Claude-3.5-Sonnet 和 Gemini-1.5-Pro 都认为样本连贯、自然、合理且与指令一致 | | 下游对象 | 检索得到的上下文示例，或用于下一动作预测的 SFT 样本 |

反馈契约是混合型：环境执行提供状态转移，基准评测器随后衡量任务完成；数据构造阶段则把重复状态规则与双模型语义委员会组合起来。委员会不会实际执行重构后的指令，也不验证终态成功，只判断给定指令与行为是否在语义上合理。逐条投票、理由、置信度、拒绝原因和精确模型修订版均未发布。

枚举所有连续片段会使候选数随轨迹长度呈二次增长。ICLR 终稿显示，85,905 条原始轨迹扩展为 1,456,808 个候选，最终 440,008 条通过筛选。它提高了昂贵交互的产出率，也产生了大量来自同一回合、彼此高度重叠的记录；审计和切分时应保留共同的回合来源。

同一批接受样本支持两种用途：训练外适配时，每一步通过智能体检索选取演示；训练式适配时，记录被转换为下一动作预测的监督微调样本。证据只支持 sft 和 agent_training，不支持把它扩展为偏好优化、奖励模型训练或策略梯度强化学习。

title: Method
方法
html:
The final paper supports the following reconstruction, while leaving a substantial reproducibility boundary.

  1. Collect source resources. SWE-bench-Lite uses non-repeated Python files. The other environments use public documentation, tutorials, and FAQs for services and applications including GitLab, Google Maps, Amazon, Reddit, Chrome, GIMP, LibreOffice, Ubuntu, Thunderbird, VLC, VS Code, dbt, Dagster, Astronomer, Airbyte, Superset, Metabase, Snowflake, BigQuery, and JupyterLab. Exact snapshots, crawl dates, URLs per record, and rights dispositions are undisclosed.
  2. Generate tasks. Claude-3.5-Sonnet samples three instructions from every document. Across 28,635 documents, this produces 85,905 attempted tasks and therefore 85,905 raw trajectories in the ICLR final. Temperature is reported as 0; exact model revision, other decoding parameters, retries, and seeds are unknown.
  3. Interact with environments. Claude-3.5-Sonnet receives the instruction, current observation, history, and environment-specific action space, predicts an action, and observes the resulting state. Episodes end on the agent's stop action or the environment maximum-step limit. Environment/container revisions and benchmark-specific limits are not reported.
  4. Construct candidates backward. For every contiguous subtrajectory, the model creates either a step summary or an abstraction of the segment's purpose. This can replace a misaligned initial goal with one that matches the observed behavior. The final reports 1,456,808 candidate pairs.
  5. Filter. Consecutive duplicate action-observation states are removed. Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-1.5-Pro then assess coherence, naturalness, reasonableness, and instruction alignment; only unanimous acceptances remain. The final retained total is 440,008.
  6. Use for ICL. At each agent step, observation-based retrieval can contribute up to five examples and model-based retrieval up to five. The latter has an LLM formulate a query from the instruction, history, and current observation, then uses stella_en_1.5B_v5 for dense retrieval.
  7. Use for SFT. Convert the pair to next-action prediction and fine-tune CodeGemma-7B or Codestral-22B with LoRA. Reported settings are batch size 128, learning rate \(2\times10^{-5}\), warmup ratio 0.03, maximum length 8192, three epochs, and 80GB H100 machines. LoRA rank, GPU count, runtime, total tokens, cost, and full execution commands remain unknown.

A faithful reproduction needs source snapshots, environment images, exact prompts and API revisions, raw-to-derived IDs, committee outputs, rejected candidates, seeds, and immutable manifests. None was found as an official reusable artifact.

ICLR 终稿支持下面这条可重建流程，同时留下明确的复现边界。

  1. 收集源资源。 SWE-bench-Lite 使用不重复的 Python 文件；其他环境使用 GitLab、Google Maps、Amazon、Reddit、Chrome、GIMP、LibreOffice、Ubuntu、Thunderbird、VLC、VS Code、dbt、Dagster、Astronomer、Airbyte、Superset、Metabase、Snowflake、BigQuery、JupyterLab 等服务或应用的公开文档、教程和 FAQ。精确快照、抓取日期、逐条 URL 与权利处置未披露。
  2. 生成任务。 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 从每份文档采样三条指令。ICLR 终稿中，28,635 份文档对应 85,905 次任务尝试，也对应 85,905 条原始轨迹。温度为 0；精确模型修订版、其他解码参数、重试规则和随机种子未知。
  3. 与环境交互。 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 接收指令、当前观察、交互历史和环境特定动作空间，预测动作并观察新状态。回合在智能体发出停止动作或达到环境最大步数时结束。环境/容器版本和各基准步数上限没有报告。
  4. 后向构造候选。 对每个连续子轨迹，模型生成步骤摘要或对片段目的的抽象描述。原始目标与轨迹不一致时，新目标可以改写为与现有行为相符。终稿报告 1,456,808 个候选对。
  5. 筛选。 先删除连续重复的动作—观察状态，再由 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 与 Gemini-1.5-Pro 评估连贯性、自然性、合理性和指令一致性；只有一致接受的样本保留，最终总数为 440,008。
  6. 用于 ICL。 每个智能体决策步最多检索五条基于观察的示例和五条基于模型的示例。后者先让 LLM 根据指令、历史和当前观察写查询，再用 stella_en_1.5B_v5 做稠密检索。
  7. 用于 SFT。 将指令—子轨迹对转换成下一动作预测，使用 LoRA 微调 CodeGemma-7B 或 Codestral-22B。已报告配置为批大小 128、学习率 \(2\times10^{-5}\)、warmup 比例 0.03、最大长度 8192、三轮训练和 80GB H100；LoRA rank、GPU 数量、运行时间、总 token、成本与完整命令未知。

忠实复现还需要源快照、环境镜像、精确提示词与 API 修订版、原始到派生记录的 ID、委员会输出、拒绝候选、随机种子和不可变清单。当前未找到这些官方可复用工件。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest construction evidence is the internally consistent count ledger in the 54-page ICLR final:

| Stage | SWE-bench-Lite | WebArena | OSWorld | Spider2-V | Total | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Documents | 6,464 | 3,578 | 7,362 | 11,231 | 28,635 | | Raw trajectories | 19,392 | 10,734 | 22,086 | 33,693 | 85,905 | | Backward-constructed candidates | 180,752 | 185,635 | 437,635 | 652,786 | 1,456,808 | | Filtered examples | 101,523 | 109,276 | 103,526 | 125,683 | 440,008 |

The raw-trajectory row is exactly three times the document row for every environment, matching the stated instruction budget. Retention from candidates to filtered examples is about 30.2% overall. This is evidence about the reported pipeline volume, not proof that retained examples are correct or independent.

The ICLR final also reports downstream behavioral evidence. Its largest ICL gain is 11.1 percentage points for Claude-3.5-Sonnet on OSWorld, from 11.4 to 22.5. For training, Codestral-22B on WebArena rises from 4.7 before tuning to 27.8 after SFT, a 23.1-point increase. The final-paper values control this Card; arXiv v1 reports older counts and headline deltas, including +12.2 ICL and +19.5 training, and should not be mixed with the venue-final tables.

Ablations support several narrower claims. Short subtrajectories are individually more useful than longer ones in the reported comparisons, while mixing short, medium, and long segments performs best under a matched 200M-token budget. Scaling experiments report continued benefits up to 100,000 examples. The backward-construction comparison reports a final-paper gain of up to 10.6 points over construction without that step.

Evaluation is environment-specific: SWE-bench applies generated patches and measures pass@1; WebArena combines Claude-based fuzzy matching with string matching; OSWorld uses task-specific environment-state scripts; Spider2-V combines file, information, and execution checks. These evaluations are meaningful for downstream agent behavior, but they combine data quality with base-model capacity, retrieval design, fine-tuning choices, and evaluator behavior.

No independent rerun, confidence interval, committee-accuracy study, record-level audit, or released corpus was found. The evidence therefore supports an effective reported recipe, not verified artifact availability or sample-level quality.

构造流程最强的证据，是 54 页 ICLR 终稿中内部一致的统计账本：

| 阶段 | SWE-bench-Lite | WebArena | OSWorld | Spider2-V | 总计 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 文档 | 6,464 | 3,578 | 7,362 | 11,231 | 28,635 | | 原始轨迹 | 19,392 | 10,734 | 22,086 | 33,693 | 85,905 | | 后向构造候选 | 180,752 | 185,635 | 437,635 | 652,786 | 1,456,808 | | 筛选后样本 | 101,523 | 109,276 | 103,526 | 125,683 | 440,008 |

每个环境的原始轨迹数都正好是文档数的三倍，与“每份文档生成三条指令”的预算一致。从候选到保留样本的总体通过率约为 30.2%。这能证明论文所报告的流程规模，但不能证明保留样本正确或相互独立。

ICLR 终稿还给出下游行为证据。最大的 ICL 提升出现在 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 的 OSWorld：从 11.4 上升到 22.5，增加 11.1 个百分点。训练方面，Codestral-22B 在 WebArena 上由微调前 4.7 上升至 SFT 后 27.8，增加 23.1 个百分点。本 Card 以终稿为准；arXiv v1 报告了更早的统计和标题数字，包括 ICL +12.2、训练 +19.5，不能与会场终稿表格混用。

消融实验支持更窄的结论：单独比较时，短子轨迹比长子轨迹更有效；在相同 200M token 预算下，短、中、长混合效果最好。扩展实验报告样本量增至 100,000 时仍有收益。与不做后向构造的方案相比，终稿报告该步骤最多带来 10.6 个百分点提升。

评测方式随环境变化：SWE-bench 应用生成补丁并测量 pass@1；WebArena 结合 Claude 模糊匹配与字符串匹配；OSWorld 使用任务特定的环境状态脚本；Spider2-V 结合文件、信息和执行检查。这些评测能反映下游智能体行为，但效果同时受到基础模型、检索设计、微调选择和评测器的影响。

尚未找到独立复现、置信区间、委员会准确性研究、逐条记录审计或已发布语料。因此，证据支持“论文报告的方法有效”，不支持“工件已开放”或“每条样本质量已验证”。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not autonomous task generation by itself, environment interaction by itself, or supervised next-action tuning. It is the combination of exhaustive contiguous-subtrajectory extraction with backward instruction construction: the system uses the behavior that actually occurred to write a locally aligned task, including when the original attempt detoured or failed.

That design changes the unit economics of agent-data synthesis. One costly raw interaction can yield many training objects, and imperfect full episodes need not be discarded wholesale. The count expansion from 85,905 episodes to 1,456,808 candidates demonstrates this mechanism at scale. It also makes the record contract more local: the object says “perform the behavior in this segment,” rather than necessarily claiming “solve the seed task.”

The accompanying agentic retrieval is also tailored to sequential environments. Observation-based retrieval looks for examples containing the current observation, while model-based retrieval formulates a query using the task, interaction history, and current state. Their combination can change demonstrations as the agent moves through the environment, unlike fixed instruction-only retrieval.

The paper does not establish novelty for self-instruct, synthetic trajectories, LLM judging, dense retrieval, LoRA, or next-action SFT in isolation. Nor does backward construction make execution feedback equivalent to verification: the committee accepts semantic alignment, while original-goal success and safety may remain unknown.

For reasoning-data curation, the important direction signal is that goal labeling can be treated as a post hoc data-construction operation. This makes lineage unusually important. A reusable record should bind the seed document, original instruction, full raw episode, selected span, constructed instruction, construction prompt/model, original-task outcome, committee votes, and final downstream conversion. Without that binding, the novel recovery mechanism is hard to distinguish from label laundering or correlated duplication during audit.

最有辨识度的贡献，不是单独的自主任务生成、环境交互或监督式下一动作训练，而是“穷举连续子轨迹 + 后向构造指令”的组合：系统根据实际发生的行为编写局部一致的任务，即使原始尝试曾绕路或失败。

这一设计改变了智能体数据合成的产出结构。一次昂贵的原始交互可以产生许多训练对象，不完整的回合也不必全部丢弃。从 85,905 条回合扩展到 1,456,808 个候选，直接体现了该机制的规模。同时，记录契约变得更局部：它表达的是“执行本片段中的行为”，而不一定声称“解决原始种子任务”。

配套的智能体检索也针对序列环境设计。基于观察的检索寻找包含当前观察的示例；基于模型的检索则利用任务、交互历史和当前状态生成查询。两者结合后，演示可以随智能体在环境中的移动而改变，而不是始终使用固定的指令级检索结果。

论文并未证明 self-instruct、合成轨迹、LLM 评审、稠密检索、LoRA 或下一动作 SFT 本身具有新颖性。后向构造也没有把执行反馈变成验证：委员会接受的是语义一致性，原始目标成功与安全性仍可能未知。

对推理数据研究而言，重要方向信号是：目标标签可以成为事后数据构造操作。这使血缘关系格外关键。理想的可复用记录应绑定种子文档、原始指令、完整原始回合、选中片段、重构指令、构造提示词与模型、原始任务结果、委员会投票及最终下游转换。如果没有这些绑定，审计时很难区分“回收有用行为”与“通过改标签掩盖失败”或“制造相关重复”。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No reusable release was found. The official paper, proceedings page, OpenReview record, arXiv record, and author page do not provide confirmed code, generated data, project site, model checkpoint, dataset card, or immutable release. The reported corpus must not be described as open.
  • Backward relabeling changes the success claim. A failed or accidental path can become an apparently aligned record after its goal is rewritten. Alignment to the new instruction does not prove original-task completion, optimality, necessity, or safety.
  • The semantic verifier is not an executor. Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-1.5-Pro judge coherence, naturalness, reasonableness, and alignment, but no calibration set, exact API revision, per-item vote, rationale, confidence, disagreement analysis, or independently labeled accuracy is released.
  • Candidates are strongly correlated. Exhaustive spans from one episode overlap and can differ by only one boundary step. No raw-episode group identifier, group-aware split, near-duplicate audit, or trajectory-family leakage analysis is reported.
  • Provenance is aggregate. Live documentation and benchmark environments are not snapshot-pinned. Per-record URLs, document versions, crawl dates, environment/container revisions, action-space versions, transformations, and source licenses are absent.
  • Benchmark overlap is unresolved. Synthesis deliberately uses resources tied to the evaluated environment families. The paper reports no task-, instruction-, code-, or semantic-overlap study against evaluation instances.
  • Substitution can shift the target domain. When target documentation is unavailable, related-domain resources may be used—for example, Amazon documentation for a WebArena shopping environment. The fidelity of this substitution is not separately measured.
  • Rights do not transfer automatically. CC BY 4.0 covers the paper, not necessarily the unreleased generated corpus, third-party documentation snapshots, environment observations, or model outputs. Artifact licensing and rights lineage are unknown.
  • Reproduction inputs are incomplete. Exact prompts as executable files, model revisions, seeds, retries, maximum steps, LoRA rank, GPU count, runtime, token consumption, cost, dependency lockfiles, raw candidates, and rejection ledger are unavailable.
  • Version drift matters. arXiv v1 and the ICLR final contain different counts and headline results. Mixing versions can produce an internally inconsistent reconstruction; this Card uses the final proceedings paper.
  • Evaluation is not a sample audit. Reported benchmark gains do not establish correctness, diversity, safety, provenance, decontamination, licensing, or independent reproducibility of the 440,008 retained records.

• 未找到可复用发布。 官方论文、proceedings 页面、OpenReview、arXiv 和作者主页均未提供已确认的代码、生成数据、项目站、模型检查点、dataset card 或不可变发布版本；不能把论文中报告的语料称为已开放。
  • 后向重标注改变了成功命题。 失败或偶然路径在重写目标后可能成为表面一致的记录；与新指令一致，不证明原始任务完成，也不证明路径最优、必要或安全。
  • 语义评审器不是执行器。 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 和 Gemini-1.5-Pro 判断连贯、自然、合理和一致，但没有发布校准集、精确 API 修订版、逐条投票、理由、置信度、分歧分析或独立标注准确率。
  • 候选高度相关。 从同一回合穷举的片段彼此重叠，可能只相差一个边界步骤。论文未报告原始回合分组 ID、按组切分、近重复审计或轨迹家族泄漏分析。
  • 来源只在聚合层披露。 在线文档与基准环境没有固定快照；逐条 URL、文档版本、抓取时间、环境/容器和动作空间版本、转换步骤、源许可证均缺失。
  • 基准重叠未解决。 合成过程有意使用与四个下游环境相关的资源，但未报告针对评测实例的任务、指令、代码或语义重叠研究。
  • 替代资源可能造成域偏移。 目标文档不可用时，方法会使用相关领域资源，例如以 Amazon 文档支持 WebArena 购物环境；这种替代的保真度没有单独测量。
  • 论文许可不会自动转移。 CC BY 4.0 覆盖论文，不必然覆盖未发布的生成语料、第三方文档快照、环境观察或模型输出；工件许可证和权利血缘未知。
  • 复现输入不完整。 可执行提示词、模型修订版、种子、重试、最大步数、LoRA rank、GPU 数量、运行时间、token 消耗、成本、依赖锁文件、原始候选与拒绝账本都没有发布。
  • 版本漂移会影响结论。 arXiv v1 与 ICLR 终稿的统计和标题结果不同；混用会得到内部不一致的重建，本 Card 统一使用 proceedings 终稿。
  • 评测不是逐样本审计。 基准性能提升不能证明 440,008 条记录的正确性、多样性、安全性、来源、去污染、许可或独立可复现性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, Learn-by-interact is most useful as a construction pattern and audit target, not as a downloadable dataset.

  • Interaction-to-SFT recipe. Teams with a controllable environment can seed tasks from operational documentation, retain full state/action logs, derive span-level instructions, and train next-action models. Each derived row should preserve raw-episode and span IDs so related examples remain groupable.
  • Failure-recovery study. Compare three ledgers: episodes that solve the original task, episodes that fail but yield useful relabeled spans, and episodes rejected entirely. Evaluate both original-goal success and constructed-goal executability to determine whether backward construction recovers skill or merely changes the label.
  • Verifier audit. Separate mechanical inactivity checks, semantic committee judgments, and environment execution. Release every judge input/output and a human-audited stratified sample, including unanimous accepts, unanimous rejects, and disagreements.
  • Correlation-aware scaling. Measure gains by unique raw episodes and source documents as well as derived-example count. Split by episode and document before studying sample scaling, because 100,000 overlapping spans are not equivalent to 100,000 independent interactions.
  • Agentic retrieval research. Evaluate observation-only, model-query, and combined retrieval under fixed token and model-call budgets. Track retrieved span provenance, repeated-example rate, state-match errors, and whether demonstrations expose evaluation answers.
  • Release-contract design. A credible open implementation would pin source snapshots, environment/container images, prompts, model/API revisions, accepted and rejected records, raw-to-derived lineage, licenses, checksums, and evaluation splits. Paper counts alone are insufficient.

Reuse class: suitable as a conceptual recipe for SFT and agent training, and as a case study in backward labeling and sequential retrieval. Direct corpus reuse is blocked because no official machine-readable data or implementation was found. Preference training, reward-model training, and RL replay are also unsupported because the paper does not release comparison groups, scalar rewards, log probabilities, or policy-run state.

在 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes 轨道中，Learn-by-interact 最适合作为数据构造模式和审计对象，而不是可直接下载的数据集。

  • 从交互到 SFT 的配方。 拥有可控环境的团队可以从操作文档生成任务，保留完整状态/动作日志，派生片段级指令，再训练下一动作模型。每条派生记录都应保留原始回合 ID 和片段 ID，确保相关样本仍可分组。
  • 失败回收研究。 建立三份账本：完成原始任务的回合、原始失败但产生有用重标注片段的回合、完全拒绝的回合。同时评测原始目标成功率与重构目标可执行性，判断后向构造是在回收技能还是仅仅改写标签。
  • 评审器审计。 分开记录机械式无动作检查、语义委员会判断和环境执行结果。发布所有评审输入输出及分层人工审计样本，覆盖一致接受、一致拒绝与存在分歧三类。
  • 考虑相关性的扩展研究。 除派生样本数外，还按独立原始回合数与源文档数报告收益。研究规模效应前按回合和文档切分，因为 100,000 条重叠片段并不等于 100,000 次独立交互。
  • 智能体检索研究。 在固定 token 与模型调用预算下比较仅观察、模型查询和组合检索；跟踪检索片段来源、重复示例率、状态匹配错误，以及演示是否泄露评测答案。
  • 开放发布契约设计。 可信的开放实现应固定源快照、环境/容器镜像、提示词、模型/API 修订版、接受与拒绝记录、原始到派生血缘、许可证、校验和与评测切分。只有论文统计远远不够。

复用等级：可作为 SFT 和智能体训练的概念配方，也适合研究后向标签与序列检索；直接复用语料目前受阻，因为没有找到官方机器可读数据或实现。偏好训练、奖励模型训练和强化学习重放同样缺少支持，因为论文没有发布比较组、标量奖励、log probability 或策略运行状态。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use the 54-page ICLR proceedings paper as the controlling version. arXiv v1 is useful for chronology but contains older counts and results. Keep the final accounting chain intact: 28,635 documents → 85,905 raw trajectories → 1,456,808 backward-constructed candidates → 440,008 filtered examples; the exact 3× relation between documents and raw trajectories follows from three generated instructions per document.
  • Read the data object as \(I'\) plus a contiguous \(T'\), not as a verified solution to the original instruction. Backward construction either summarizes the executed steps or abstracts their apparent purpose, and can relabel behavior after an original-task mismatch.
  • Separate the duplicate-state rule from the semantic committee. Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-1.5-Pro must unanimously judge coherence, naturalness, reasonableness, and instruction alignment, but they do not execute the new instruction.
  • In ICL, distinguish observation-based retrieval from model-based retrieval: each supplies at most five examples per step. In SFT, records become next-action prediction examples; do not infer reward-model or RL training. Short spans are best individually, while a short/medium/long mixture is best under the reported 200M-token comparison.
  • The final reports Claude on OSWorld at 11.4→22.5 (+11.1) with ICL and Codestral-22B on WebArena at 4.7→27.8 (+23.1) after SFT. These downstream gains are not a sample-level quality certificate.
  • Treat source URLs, environment versions, model revisions, rejection reasons, original-task success flags, seeds, compute totals, and release artifacts as unknown unless separately published. An official paper exists, but no official code/data/model/project/release artifact was found; reported counts are not an availability claim.

• 以 54 页 ICLR proceedings 终稿为控制版本；arXiv v1 只适合追溯版本历史，统计和结果较旧。完整终稿账本是 28,635 份文档 → 85,905 条原始轨迹 → 1,456,808 个后向构造候选 → 440,008 条筛选样本；文档与原始轨迹严格 1:3，源于每份文档生成三条指令。
  • 数据对象是 \(I'\) 加连续 \(T'\)，不要把它理解为原始指令的已验证解。后向构造可以概括执行步骤或抽象行为目的，也能在原始任务与轨迹不一致时重标注行为。
  • 将重复状态规则与语义委员会分开理解。Claude-3.5-Sonnet 和 Gemini-1.5-Pro 必须一致认定样本连贯、自然、合理且与指令一致，但它们不会执行重构后的新指令。
  • ICL 中应区分基于观察与基于模型的检索，两者每步各最多五条。SFT 则把记录转成下一动作预测样本，不能据此推断奖励模型或强化学习训练。短片段单独最好，但 200M token 对比中短、中、长混合池最佳。
  • 终稿报告 Claude 在 OSWorld 上通过 ICL 从 11.4 升至 22.5（+11.1），Codestral-22B 在 WebArena 上经 SFT 从 4.7 升至 27.8（+23.1）。这些下游收益不是逐样本质量证明。
  • 未另行发布之前，源 URL、环境版本、模型修订版、拒绝原因、原始任务成功标记、随机种子、计算总量和发布工件都应视为未知。官方论文存在，但未找到官方代码、数据、模型、项目或发布工件；不能把报告数量改写成可获取性声明。

items: Backward construction may turn a failed or accidental path into a superficially aligned record by changing the goal, without proving the behavior is necessary, safe, or successful for the original task.
Filtering depends on two proprietary LLM judges without exact API revisions, calibration, inter-judge agreement, or an independently labeled quality audit.
Quadratic extraction creates many correlated subtrajectories from the same raw episode; no group-aware splitting, near-duplicate analysis, or trajectory-family leakage control is reported.
Documentation can be incomplete or unavailable, and related-domain resources are sometimes substituted for the target environment.
Live external documentation and benchmark environments are not snapshot-pinned, making exact replay and rights auditing difficult.
No generated corpus, rejected set, implementation, environment lockfile, trained checkpoint, source snapshot, or immutable release manifest was found.
No confidence intervals, independent synthesis/training reruns, random seeds, total compute accounting, or task-overlap study is reported.
The arXiv v1 and ICLR final report different headline deltas; downstream citations must use the venue-final values.
反向构造可能通过改变目标将失败或偶然路径变成表面上对齐的记录，而未证明该行为对原始任务是必要、安全或成功的。
过滤依赖于两个专有 LLM 评审模型，而无确切 API 修订、校准、评审间一致性或独立标注的质量审计。
二次提取从同一原始 episode 产生许多相关子轨迹；未报告分组感知划分、近重复分析或轨迹族泄漏控制。
文档可能不完整或不可得，有时用相关领域资源替代目标环境。
实时外部文档与基准环境未固定快照，使精确重放与权利审计困难。
未发现生成语料、拒绝集、实现、环境 lockfile、已训练 checkpoint、来源快照或不可变发布清单。
未报告置信区间、独立合成/训练重跑、随机种子、总计算量核算或任务重叠研究。
arXiv v1 与 ICLR 终稿报告不同的头条差值；下游引用必须使用发表场所终稿数值。
